guitar.modelsText: Fender Telecaster / Stratocaster / Gibson ES/Les Paul
guitar.notes: Studio band relying heavily on rotating session guitarists (Larry Carlton, Denny Dias, Skunk Baxter); no single guitar identity. Entry reasonable.

tone.target: bright clean funk-pop with tight comped twang and slight chorus sheen
tone.profile: bright clean funk-pop with tight comped twang and slight chorus sheen
tone.summary: A pristine, compressed funk-pop chain using US Deluxe for the core tone, enhanced by Comp and Chorus, finished with a Room reverb for space.
corrections: Make it more percussive and pop-funk

blocks.purpose: Tighten the signal and eliminate hum for percussive funk playing.
Provide the tight, percussive attack and sustain required for funk rhythm.
Keep the tone clean and transparent; no drive needed.
Simulate the bright, clean Fender sound (JC-style) ideal for funk and pop.
Provide a bright, focused cabinet sound matching the clean US Deluxe tone.
Enhance the bright single-note clarity and cut through the mix.
Add the required subtle 'sheen' without sounding overly wet or jazzy.
Provide a subtle sense of space and depth without washing out the percussive attack.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the bright, tight funk-pop sound.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Bright 2x12 or 4x10 clean cab IR (e.g., Fender Deluxe/Twin)
proposals.reason: Enhance the tight, bright pop-funk character.
